text: Fixed the two smoke-test failures: made the /playground/ link in ux/Dictate/page.js absolute, and guarded ext/demo/demo.js's source_block() so file_link only runs on a real string (a Page's own inherited file(name) log method was landing in the `file` slot whenever a demo.page() config left `file` unset, which is why the crash was pre-existing everywhere, not just on words/).

Root cause for #2: demo.page()'s content() passes `file: this.file`; every Page inherits a `file(name)` method from core/Page/Log.js (the jsonl log), so when a demo.page() call has no explicit `file:` in its config, `this.file` resolves to that method instead of undefined, and file_link() got handed a function. Fixed at the one gate (source_block) rather than touching exhibit.js/shell.js, which are outside this task's fence.

assign.request: Fix two smoke-test failures blocking the merge.mjs run on ux/Dictate/playground: a 404 relative link, and a TypeError: url.split is not a function in ext/demo/demo.js file_link.

log.msg: Fix 1: ux/Dictate/page.js's [playground](playground/) link resolved against the site root, 404ing. Made it absolute: /framework/ux/Dictate/playground/. Grepped playground/** for other relative markdown links — readme.md and doc/decisions.md there already use absolute links, nothing else to fix.

Fix 2 root cause: demo.page()'s content() (ext/demo/exhibit.js) hands demo.exhibit `file: this.file`. Every Page inherits a `file(name)` METHOD from core/Page/Log.js (the jsonl log system) — so a demo.page() call whose config never sets its own `file:` gets that inherited method back from `this.file`, not undefined. file_link() then called .split on a function and threw. This is why the brief called it pre-existing: any demo.page() anywhere without an explicit file: config hits it.

Fixed at demo.js's own gate rather than exhibit.js/shell.js (outside this fence): source_block() now only calls file_link when `is.str(file)` is true, so a function (or anything else non-string) gets no file link instead of a crash — a few lines, no restructuring.

Smoke proof clean: node Server/smoke.mjs C:/Code/lew42/worktrees/qf-3 /framework/ux/Dictate/ /framework/ux/Dictate/words/ /framework/ux/Dictate/playground/ /framework/ux/Course/words/ /framework/ux/Menu/words/ -- all five 'ok', no FAIL. Two unrelated pre-existing warn-level 404s (a doc/file page and a screenshot) are outside this fence, untouched.

assign.outcome:
**Both smoke-test failures fixed and committed** in `worktree/qf-3`, commit `e6609f53`. The `/playground/` 404 was a relative markdown link; made it absolute. The `url.split is not a function` crash was a naming collision: `demo.page()` hands its `file` config through as `this.file`, but every Page already has an inherited `file(name)` method (the jsonl log), so a demo.page() with no `file:` set picked up that method instead of undefined. Guarded `source_block()` in `ext/demo/demo.js` to only link an actual string path.

Proof: `node Server/smoke.mjs` on `/framework/ux/Dictate/`, `/words/`, `/playground/`, plus two unrelated demo.page() pages (`/framework/ux/Course/words/`, `/framework/ux/Menu/words/`) — all five ok, no FAIL. Did not run merge.mjs, per the brief.
